projects.title: Omnisys HubBlocks
projects.description: A Minecraft plugin that allows players to have custom hub blocks in the game. It provides a way to create interactive elements in the hub area, enhancing the player experience and adding a unique touch to the server.

projects.title: Omnisys RanksPro
projects.description: A Minecraft plugin that allows server administrators to manage player ranks and permissions. It provides a way to create and customize ranks, assign permissions, and manage player access to various features on the server.

projects.title: Omnisys JoinMessages
projects.description: "Omnicraft Network Join Messages" (2022), this plugin allowed server administrators to customize the join and leave messages that players see when they enter or exit the server.

projects.title: Omnisys PrivateMessages
projects.description: A Minecraft plugin that allows players to send private messages to each other. It provides a way for players to communicate without broadcasting their messages to the entire server.

projects.title: Omnisys ChestLocker
projects.description: A Minecraft plugin that allows players to lock their chests and other containers. It provides a way for players to protect their items from theft or unauthorized access.

projects.title: Omnisys StaffHomes
projects.description: A Minecraft plugin that allows staff members to set and teleport to their own homes. It provides a convenient way for staff to manage their own spaces within the game.

projects.title: Omnisys Launchpads
projects.description: A Minecraft plugin that adds launchpads to the game. Players can use launchpads to propel themselves into the air, allowing faster navigation.

projects.title: Omnisys SilkTouchSpawnerFix
projects.description: A simple plugin that fixes the issue of Silk Touch not working on spawners in Minecraft. It was a small but useful plugin for players who wanted to collect spawners without losing them.

projects.title: Omnisys WeatherDayCycleFix
projects.description: "A simple WeatherCycle and DayCycle fix" (2022), this plugin was designed to address issues related to the weather and day-night cycle in Minecraft. It provided a way to lock the weather and daylight cycle, for lobby/world management.

projects.title: Omnisys Vanish
projects.description: "A simple vanish plugin" (2022), this plugin allowed players to become invisible to others on the server. It was a useful tool for server administrators and moderators who needed to monitor player activity without being seen.
features: Allow the player to become invisible

projects.title: Omnisys Plugin Hider
projects.description: "A simple plugin to hide other plugins" this was the claim of the plugin, but it was actually much more than that. It was a plugin designed to hide the presence of other plugins on a Minecraft server, making it harder for players to detect and identify them. It achieved this by intercepting and modifying various server events and responses related to plugin information.

versions.title: Omnisys Plugin Hider v1.0.2-HOTFIX - The Stealth Mode
versions.description: This version of the Omnisys Plugin Hider focused on improving the stealth capabilities of the plugin. It included enhancements to the plugin hiding mechanism, making it more effective at concealing the presence of other plugins on the server. Additionally, it introduced new features to hide server software information and block certain commands that could reveal plugin details.

projects.title: OmniSuggester
projects.description: A Discord bot designed to facilitate feature suggestions for my OmniCraft Minecraft server. It allows users to submit their ideas, upvote or downvote existing suggestions, and provides an anonymous submission option to encourage honest feedback.

versions.title: OmniSuggester v1.0.0-release - The community's voice
versions.description: The first version of OmniSuggester was a simple bot that allowed users to submit their suggestions for the OmniCraft server. It had a basic upvote/downvote system and an anonymous submission option.

projects.title: First Java Standalone Program
projects.description: My first ever Java standalone program. It was a simple console application that allowed users to input their name and then greeted them with a personalized message. It was a great learning experience and helped me understand the basics of Java programming.
features: Personalized greeting based on user input

projects.title: Omnisys Minecraft Plugin
projects.description: This was my first ever Minecraft plugin, developed for the OmniCraft Minecraft server. It wasn't that meaningful, but it was a great learning experience and a stepping stone to more complex projects.

versions.title: Omnisys Minecraft Plugin v1.0.0-alpha - The first plugin
versions.description: The first version of the Omnisys Minecraft plugin was a simple plugin that added a few basic commands and features to the OmniCraft server.

versions.title: Omnisys Minecraft Plugin v1.1.0-alpha -
versions.description: The second version of the Omnisys Minecraft plugin added more features and commands, including a random teleport command, spawn setting command, and various gamemode command abbreviations.

versions.title: OmniCraft Website v1.0-beta - The first ever website
versions.description: The first version of the OmniCraft website was a simple static site with basic information about the server and its features.

versions.title: OmniCraft Website v1.0.0-release - The launch

projects.title: Omnisys
projects.description: A multi-purpose Discord bot with a variety of features to enhance my discord server user experience.

versions.title: Omnisys v1.0.0-alpha - Love at first sight
versions.description: Omnisys was actually my first programming project. Here's where I wrote my first line of code.

versions.title: Omnisys v1.1.0-alpha - The evolution
versions.description: After a few weeks of development, Omnisys had evolved into a more feature-rich bot with a modular command system and customizable prefixes.

versions.title: Omnisys v2.0.0-alpha - The database integration
versions.description: The biggest update to Omnisys was the integration of a database to store user data and settings. This allowed for more advanced features and better performance.

versions.title: Omnisys v2.1.0-alpha - TypeScript migration
versions.description: The latest update to Omnisys was the migration from JavaScript to TypeScript. This allowed for better code quality, improved maintainability, and easier debugging.

versions.title: Omnisys v1.0.0-tickets - Ticketing System
versions.description: The ticketing system was one of the most requested features for Omnisys. It allows users to create support tickets and receive assistance from moderators and staff members.

versions.title: Omnisys v1.0.0-music - Music System
versions.description: The music system was another highly requested feature for Omnisys. It allows users to play music in voice channels, create playlists, and control playback with various commands.
